items.caption: An oracle-script style form of 白 with a rounded outline and two interior strokes. Its early referent is disputed, with proposals including a thumb and a vessel.
items.alt: Rounded, loop-like black outline with two interior strokes.
items.selection_reason: Shows an early script-style shape relevant to the disputed pictorial origin; the form alone cannot identify what it depicts.

items.caption: A Shuowen seal-script style form of 白, with a tall central stroke above a divided, box-like body. Shuowen explains the graph as 入 joined with 二; this is a transmitted historical interpretation, not confirmation of its early origin.
items.alt: Tall central stroke above a box-like body divided by horizontal strokes.
items.selection_reason: Adds the transmitted dictionary tradition and its explanation, which can be distinguished from the unresolved early pictorial referent.

limitations.text: The early graph’s referent remains disputed: proposals include a thumb and a vessel, and the evidence does not establish a consensus.
These script-style forms are modern redrawings, not photographs of specific inscribed artifacts or individually dated inscription witnesses.
